summary: generateDraft saves empty LLM completion as a publishable draft
description: Found during T9 local smoke (2026-05-31). deepseek-v4-pro is a reasoning model; one run spent all tokens on reasoning_tokens and returned an EMPTY content body (finish=stop, no error). generateDraft then ran parseGenerated on '' → fell back to the concept-label title, derived a slug, and saved status='draft' with empty content + null cost — i.e. an empty post became publishable. Grounding guard only covers thin RETRIEVAL, not thin GENERATION. Fix: after parseGenerated, if the body is empty/whitespace (or below a small floor), fail(seedId, 'empty generation') → needs_attention, never a draft. Same principle as Hard Rule 2 (no silent empty output). Intermittent but real. Test: blog-generate.test.ts case — stream yields only a usage chunk / blank content → needs_attention, no draft.

resolution.note: Added MIN_BODY_CHARS=200 generation floor in blog-generate.ts: after parseGenerated, an empty/whitespace body → fail()→needs_attention instead of a publishable draft. Companion to the thin-retrieval guard. Root cause: deepseek-v4-pro (reasoning model) can return finish=stop with all tokens spent on reasoning_tokens and an empty content body. Test added (10 blog-generate tests pass); full suite 435 green; tsc clean.
